announced on Wednesday that it won a task order worth up to $43.7M from the to National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) for IT services.
The contract includes a base period and options covering 2.5 years, supporting about 2K NHLBI employees and contractors.
The company has supported the NHLBI mission since 2018, extending its long-running federal health IT relationship.
The work includes AI-powered IT operations, cloud infrastructure, application support, cybersecurity, service desk, and technology support.
The award strengthens the company's position in federal health IT and extends its role supporting the NHLBI’s biomedical research operations.

title: DLH Holdings wins up to a $43.7M NHLBI IT task order
